verdict.rationale: Wave's only explicit bulk capability is receipt import, capped at 10 receipts at a time with OCR extraction. Pro also automatically imports, merges and categorizes bank transactions, which acts across many items but is background automation, not a user-driven bulk action. missing for 10: bulk edit/delete/recategorize across selected items, bulk invoice actions, any API/CLI surface for programmatic bulk operations (the developer portal could not be crawled and marketing pages document none), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
